notes.title: v1.0.4 [patch 4]
notes.content:
[b]ADDITION[/b]
- A Discord link have been added in the main menu.

[b]OPTIMIZATIONS[/b]
- The size of the textures has been decreased, they are now more optimized.
- Several unnecessary colliders have been removed.

notes.title: v1.0.3 [patch 3]
notes.content:
[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
- The "Maintain" and "Maintain and release in good moment" actions (SAs). If the input of the next action is the same as the previous one, it won't activate it, you have to press the button again to avoid being surprised or failing.
- The text indicating that the district is finished now appears on the 4 districts (in addition to the central district already present).
- In the district 2 in 1 road they are missing car, they are now present.

notes.title: v1.0.1 [patch 1]
notes.content:
[b]ADDITIONS[/b]
- Adding of a feedback text at the bottom when a district is finish.
- Adding for left-handed the right alphanumeric keyboard.

[b]CHANGE[/b]
- The letter "R" is removed. The new letter is "C" to be more similar of the right alphanumeric keyboard.

[b]BUG FIXE[/b]
- The arrow up and down for move the camera are not now inversed.
